title: DevShelf Free Cloud Service
description: Schema for cloud databases, hosting, and backend services with perpetual free tiers

name.description: Name of the cloud platform or service

url.description: Official website or pricing page URL

category.description: Cloud service category (e.g. Databases & BaaS, Cloud Hosting & PaaS)

description.description: Objective explanation of the platform capabilities

freeTier.description: Detailed specification of the non-expiring free allowance

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent HTTP endpoint reachability check

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry existence was verified by maintainer or automated pipeline

pricingVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when zero-paywall pricing terms and free tier were verified

authRequirements.description: Detailed authentication requirement (e.g. none, free api key, oauth, registration)

freeTierLimits.description: Specific free tier limits or perpetual zero-cost quotas

verifiedZeroPaywall.description: Whether the resource is verified to have an authentic, permanent zero-paywall tier

redirectUrl.description: Tracked redirect target URL if destination moved
